description:

name: Rus Stable into 2TC (all MATCHUPS)
author: Valdemar1902

notes: Pull 4 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ from @resource/sheep.png@ to build @landmark_rus/kremlin.png@ on @resource/resource_stone.png@ (for 2nd tc) / @resource/resource_gold.png@ (for FC or Full Aggro)
Leave 6 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ on @resource/sheep.png@ and go up to 5@unit_worker/villager.png@ on 3 @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@ -> @building_economy/lumber-camp.png@.

4 age up @unit_worker/villager.webp@ instantly build @building_military/stable.png@->@building_economy/house.png@ ->@building_economy/mining-camp.png@@resource/resource_gold.png@ (produce 1-3 @unit_cavalry/knight-2.png@ for harass)

2 @unit_worker/villager.webp@' to @resource/resource_gold.png@ then @resource/rally.png@ to @resource/resource_wood.png@ . (as you get 11+ vills on wood, you take batches of vills out on pocket resources like @resource/deer.png@/@resource/boar.png@ )

Age up with @landmark_rus/high-trade-house.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.png@ and remacro on @resource/resource_wood.png@ for production

description:
This is a pro scout build

Standard Build to go FC into units, 2tc or imperial.
name: RUS Fast Castle (updated 2025)
author: Valdemar1902

notes: Send 5 @unit_worker/villager.png@ to gather 50 @resource/resource_wood.png@ from a @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@ then go to @resource/sheep.png@
1 @unit_worker/villager.png@build @building_rus/hunting-cabin.png@ on first woodline then @building_economy/house.png@ then goes to @resource/sheep.png@
New @unit_worker/villager.webp@ builds 2nd @building_rus/hunting-cabin.png@ on opposite woodline ( or to the side of the first one opposite the first @building_rus/hunting-cabin.png@)
When first @building_rus/hunting-cabin.webp@ is finished you queue up a @unit_cavalry/scout.png@
Time to age up and remacro. Age up with @landmark_rus/high-trade-house.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.png@ close to base for safety.
Remacro and build @building_religious/monastery.webp@. make a few @unit_rus/horse-archer-3.png@ for @resource/relics.png@ collection
Here you can go 2TC. I like to get 50 @resource/resource_stone.webp@ with 5 vills long distance gather. Then buy 300 @resource/resource_stone.png@ from @landmark_rus/the-golden-gate.png@

description:
This is a pro scout build

Good against Cavalry civs and FC civs like OOTD, HRE, Ayyubid

Timing is when opponent runs out of food (thats when u push)

Go either 2TC in castle if opp went 2TC 

If opp is doing 1 TC FC as well go 1TC all in
name: RUS Fast Castle Horse Archers Guide (legacy)
author: Valdemar1902

notes: Send 5 @unit_worker/villager.png@ to gather 50 @resource/resource_wood.png@ from a @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@ then go to @resource/sheep.png@
1 @unit_worker/villager.png@build @building_rus/hunting-cabin.png@ on first woodline then @building_economy/house.png@ then goes to @resource/sheep.png@
New @unit_worker/villager.webp@ builds 2nd @building_rus/hunting-cabin.png@ on opposite woodline ( or to the side of the first one opposite the first @building_rus/hunting-cabin.png@)
When first @building_rus/hunting-cabin.webp@ is finished you queue up a @unit_cavalry/scout.png@

Queue up a @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ and sell for 150 @resource/resource_gold.png@ in the @landmark_rus/the-golden-gate.png@ to afford @technology_economy/professional-scouts.png@ from Hunting Cabins. You start collecting enemy deer for castle.
@building_rus/wooden-fortress.webp@ on woodline (or earlier if enemy is aggro)
full produce @unit_rus/horse-archer-3.webp@ and wait for enemy reaction until adding units to composition.
If enemy is 2TC into FC, you can now think about going 2TC yourself. Buy stone or gather it.
@building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ -> 2x @building_military/stable.png@ if enemy is going @building_military/stable.png@/@unit_infantry/archer-2.png@ (prioritise ranged upgrades)
@building_rus/hunting-cabin.webp@  faz 2x @unit_cavalry/scout.png@ colocar 1 para cada lado do mapa explorando em direção ao inimigo

description: This is the newly updated Beastyqt's Rus build order for Pro Scouting into Fast Castle for season 11.
name: Rus Pro Scout into Fast Castle (Beasty)
author: Thoren

notes: 5 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ to get 50 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ from @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ and 1 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ build @building_rus/hunting-cabin.webp@and @building_economy/house.webp@ on woodline
5 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ from @resource/resource_wood.webp@ to @resource/sheep.webp@ and 1 new @unit_worker/villager.webp@ build @building_rus/hunting-cabin.webp@ on the other side of the woods
Add @unit_worker/villager.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ to 8 and @resource/rally.webp@ back to @resource/resource_food.webp@

Sell @resource/resource_food.webp@ or @resource/resource_wood.webp@ at @landmark_rus/the-golden-gate.webp@ to research @technology_economy/professional-scouts.webp@ and produce @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ from other @building_rus/hunting-cabin.webp@ untill 6/7 total.

If opponent is making @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ to prevent you from Pro Scouting, @abilities/repair.webp@ @building_military/archery-range.webp@ and make couple @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ to escort scouts.

If opponent is making @unit_cavalry/knight-2.webp@ or @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.webp@, @abilities/repair.webp@ @building_military/barracks.webp@ and make couple @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ to escort scouts.
Bring back @resource/deer.webp@ with your @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ and research @technology_economy/survival-techniques.webp@

Build @building_rus/wooden-fortress.webp@ near @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@ and switch @unit_worker/villager.webp@ from @resource/sheep.webp@ to @resource/deer.webp@ when deer arrive under @building_economy/town-center.webp@

@landmark_rus/the-golden-gate.webp@ sell @resource/resource_wood.webp@ for @resource/resource_gold.webp@ , then 8@resource/resource_food.webp@ @unit_worker/villager.webp@ build @landmark_rus/high-trade-house.webp@ near safe woodline

Leave 8 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ on @resource/resource_food.webp@ and @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and get @technology_economy/double-broadaxe.webp@ and @technology_economy/wheelbarrow.webp@ as you're ageing up.

@abilities/repair.webp@@building_religious/monastery.webp@ and 2 more @building_military/archery-range.webp@ start producing @unit_rus/horse-archer-3.webp@ and some @unit_rus/warrior-monk.webp@ to get @resource/relics.webp@

If opponent is going all-in, @abilities/repair.webp@ @building_military/barracks.webp@ and @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ and produce @unit_infantry/man-at-arms-1.webp@ and get @technology_military/iron-undermesh.webp@
If opponent has a lot of archers and ranged units, get @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.webp@
If opponent has a diverse army, get @unit_cavalry/knight-2.webp@
If your opponent has a lot of spearman, get @unit_infantry/man-at-arms-1.webp@
If your opponent has a lot of cavalry, get @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ and/or @unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.webp@

description:
This is build is a transcription for Rus begginers from the latest Beastyqt's Rus video with emphasis on Scouting Tips and 2nd TC placement. I recommend practicing this build vs A.I where you have time to pause and read the build step by step. Once your familiar with the build, I would suggest you to check my non detailed version of this build, which is the same exact build but with less information, making it easier to read.
Let me know your opinion on this transcription either by leaving a Like, Dislike or a Comment, that way I'll know if I should continue doing this transcriptions from Beasty's videos.
name: [Beastyqt] Rus S5 2TC {zaka} - Detailed
author: zaka

notes: 1st @unit_cavalry/scout.png@ goes through the middle to either left or right
and kills @resource/deer.png@ in that enemy side of the map.
2nd @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ Produced. Send him as you did with the first scout,
but e.g. if the 1st@unit_cavalry/scout.png@ was send to the right, this one goes to the left,
be carefull not to overlap scouted areas. Kill @resource/deer.png@.
deliver them and kill the @resource/deer.png@ leftover on your side of the map.
By that time, the 1st @unit_cavalry/scout.png@ should be able to help you with that.
Once you have 150 @resource/resource_wood.webp@, build a @building_economy/house.png@ and
Once you have enough for 2nd @building_economy/town-center.webp@, leave 8@unit_worker/villager.png@ on @resource/resource_wood.png@,
Build 2nd @building_economy/town-center.png@ either on @resource/deer.png@ or @resource/boar.png@ with the rest of them.
If the opponent goes to @age/age_3.png@, keep harashing so you can buy
yourself time to slowly go @age/age_3.png@ with @landmark_rus/high-trade-house.png@.

1 @unit_worker/villager.png@build @building_rus/hunting-cabin.png@ on first woodline then @building_economy/house.png@ then goes to @resource/sheep.png@

description:
Now that pro scouts is nerfed, 2TC Kremlin is back to being more relevant.

However, this is probably not worth doing on any map that isn't Enlightened Horizons, and you shouldn't place Rus on Enlightened Horizons to begin with

The build order here is taken from the Beasty video I've linked
name: Rus 2TC Kremlin - Based on Beasty
author: TyrusLunarspear

notes: Send 5 @unit_worker/villager.png@ to gather 50 @resource/resource_wood.png@  from a @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@ then send them to @resource/sheep.png@
Send 1 @unit_worker/villager.png@ to the woodline and build @building_rus/hunting-cabin.png@ then @building_economy/house.png@ then goes to @resource/sheep.png@
First @unit_worker/villager.webp@ that pops out builds another @building_rus/hunting-cabin.png@ covering different trees then goes to @resource/sheep.png@
Queue up a @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ when first @building_rus/hunting-cabin.png@ finishes
Rally to the chopped @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ until 3 on @resource/resource_wood.png@

4 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ go to build @landmark_rus/kremlin.png@, try to build it close to @resource/deer.png@ and @resource/resource_wood.png@, if you can push the deer to it. If you can't, you can place it on the @resource/resource_stone.png@

3 @resource/resource_wood.png@@unit_worker/villager.png@ on @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@ go to @resource/resource_stone.png@ after they finish gathering, also build a @building_economy/house.png@
@resource/rally.png@ to @resource/resource_stone.png@ until you have 8 on stone
At this point you should start pushing the @resource/deer.webp@ if you can with 3 @unit_cavalry/scout.png@
Age up @unit_worker/villager.webp@ go to @resource/resource_wood.png@ near Kremlin, build a @building_economy/lumber-camp.png@
You should have enough @resource/resource_stone.webp@ (350), re-macro to @resource/resource_wood.png@ until you have 400
You should have enough @resource/resource_wood.webp@ to build a @building_economy/town-center.png@ on @resource/deer.png@ with 8 @unit_worker/villager.png@
